title: Ceramic 15oz Elephant Tea Mug Green
reviews_5s: I bought this cute mug for my granddaughter’s high school graduation. She has a favorite stuffed elephant toy I gave her when she was born so I bought this cup for her more adult persona. She loves it! It’s perfect for brewing a hot cup of tea since it’s a divided cup. I holds a large cup of your preferred liquid and is easy to hold.It’s a gift for my tea drinking friend- I’m excited to give it to her. It’s so cute!Super cute!! My first one came with slight problem with the glaze but they replaced it quickly! I loveitGiftee loved it! Others were jealous, so cute and well made.Cute, love the tea bag holder. Nice weight to keep my tea warmSo cute, as described! Bought for my elephant loving friend who also loves tea!Bought as a gift. Recipient loved itThis made such a wonderful gift. It was a great size, wonderful quality for the price especially. The person I gifted it to uses it daily for her morning tea and really appreciates the holder for the tea bag.This elephant mug is so freaking cute. I have not used it yet but the fact that it has a place for used tea bag is amazingGot this for my mother in law who loves drinking her tea. She adored it! It worked perfectly for her and was too cute. Recommend it!
reviews_1s:
I ordered the first mug and it had a big chunk of ceramic sticking straight up, very sharp on the inside of the mug. I returned it and ordered another one, it also had a sharp piece of ceramic sticking out, enough to hurt yourself if you were cleaning the inside of the mug. I'll be returning the second one as well.
I don't know what I expected for the price but these are unusable in my opinion. Don't waste your time.Quality wasn't good! Couldn't handle being heated up in microwave and a peice popped off in the microwaveI bought this as a surprise little gift for someone who loves elephants. Unfortunately the item was so poorly made I couldn’t give it to them. It arrived with a very visible defect in the ceramic (see photo). It was a complete WASTE OF MONEY!Mug started crackling as soon as hot water hit it.This is adorable but very front heavy. You have to hold the handle and the elephant trunk or it tips forward and the hot tea water or hit cup burns you.This product is made in China. the actual finishing of the glaze on the ceramic is poor. inside of the cup had a big lump of unglazed clay that was stuck there that I couldn’t pop off. the idea is great but it’s a little heavy to hold as a mug and if you’re just using the extra compartment as a used teabag holder I would not recommend it. plus on the box it says FDA approved. what mug have you ever purchased this is fda approved, to me that said warning signI have purchased this mug seeing how cute it looks but it’s not much of a use. When heated in a microwave for less than 2 minutes, the handle of the mug heats up too. Need to take it out of microwave using a cloth and let it cool down. Not serving the purpose of a having a hot beverage in it.I like the idea of placing your tea bag on your cup. Although it is hard to drink your tea. The tea bag fall out of the holder and when you bring the cup to your lips I ended up wearing my tea. Maybe it is me having MS or the cup is not created to be drank from.I ordered 1. When it came there was a huge chunk of sharp edged ceramic clay in the bottom baked into the finish. I returned it for a replacement. The replacement is also defective with several sharp pieces of ceramic baked into the glaze. When I tried to return this 2nd one it is giving me a refund option of $0 because it's a replacement. Now I am going to have to spend time calling to get my money back. Absolutely horrible product control and workmanship. Do not waste your time or money.Such a cute mug. Bought for my daughter. Says is microwave and dishwasher safe. My daughter put it in the microwave to heat up tea. Thank goodness I happen to be passing and said I’d get it for her or we’d be in the hospital now with her burnt little hands! If you use the microwave with this mug, make sure to use potholders when taking it out. It will burn you -badly!!!
